purpose: This table is the cleaned, typed reference of global airports sourced from the OurAirports bronze extract, intended to feed geospatial lookups, route analytics, and operational dashboards that join on airport id.
usage: Consumers should join on id (the declared grain), filter has_scheduled_service when restricting to commercially served airports, and treat icao_code, iata_code-adjacent codes (gps_code, local_code), municipality, and link fields as optionally null rather than assuming completeness.
limitations: No row-level deduplication was needed since duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, but several columns remain sparsely populated and unresolved: local_code (63.66% null), home_link (74.90% null), keywords (67.96% null), icao_code (13.66% null), wikipedia_link (13.08% null), gps_code (5.39% null), elevation_ft (3.70% null), and municipality (3.97% null); consumers must handle these nulls explicitly.
